1h.reason: no same-coverage PIT 1h OI + funding panel

1m.reason: only BTC 1m prices; no 24-coin PIT OI + funding panel

data_window.pitrule: daily signal at t, mark/funding PnL after t; current-day dropped

execution_assumptions.historical_microstructure_limit: historical best bid/ask and historical filter snapshots are unavailable from public endpoints; current values are labelled calibration, not substituted silently
execution_assumptions.quantity_rule: current exchangeInfo MARKET_LOT_SIZE/LOT_SIZE floor + minQty + MIN_NOTIONAL
execution_assumptions.spread: current public bookTicker half-spread applied to historical mark executions

methodology_boundaries: 日频 OI/资金费/价格 PIT 输入；无合成默认值
区间级 signal-at-start / PnL-after-start，无同区间前视
成本为手续费 + 参与率/铺开天数缩放的冲击近似
未使用历史盘口、历史 exchangeInfo 过滤器或真实整数手数
未以本诊断结果替代完整九引擎研究风险门和前向 8 周门
